title: ServiceBlock
description: A single rendered block in an assembled Orthodox service. The assembler returns ordered arrays of these (`ServiceBlock[]`). Produced by `assembler.js#makeBlock` and consumed by the HTML renderer and downstream API clients.

id.description: Stable identifier unique within the assembled service. Used as the React-key equivalent for client rendering and as an audit-trail anchor.

section.description: Human-readable parent section label (e.g. 'Lord, I Have Cried', 'The Entrance', 'Aposticha'). Used for display grouping and search facets.

type.description: What kind of block this is, for rendering and filtering. `rubric` = stage direction; `prayer` = spoken text; `hymn` = sung text; `verse` = psalm verse paired with a sticheron; `response` = liturgical answer (Amen, Lord have mercy); `doxology` = trinitarian formula.

speaker.description: Who says or sings this block. `null` is permitted for blocks that have no speaker attribution (e.g. ambient rubrics).

text.description: The rendered text. May be empty for some structural blocks but the field itself is required. Empty-text blocks are flagged by `audit/endpoint-audit.js`.

tone.description: Tone (mode) number 1–8 when the block belongs to the Octoechos cycle or is otherwise tone-assigned.

source.description: Which liturgical book this block was drawn from. Common values: `octoechos`, `menaion`, `triodion`, `pentecostarion`, `fixed`, `db`. Used for provenance display and the choir-prep filter.

label.description: Optional display label rendered above the text (e.g. 'For the Martyrs', 'Dogmatikon', 'Theotokion').

_overlay.description: Assembler-added: the translation overlay id (e.g. `htm-boston`, `st-john-damascus-tyler`) whose override produced this text. Absent when the text comes from the base layer. See `fixed-texts/translations/`.

_source.description: Assembler-added: provenance tag for content awaiting OCA-translation replacement. Used by `audit:date` to surface tracked gaps. Always carries traceability per STYLE.md §5.

examples.speaker: choir
examples.text: The passion-bearers of Christ have shone forth as suns…
examples.label: For the Martyrs
